note: Module-level literal constants of the four archived controller files used by the analyses, and the SHA-256 of each file. The hashes equal the values recorded in every primary and pilot run log (provenance.files_sha256). Three of these files (clasp_policy.py, aegis_time.py and timed_variants.py) are released in safebench/; the rest of the controller source is available from the corresponding author.
deployed_values_note: The R_HUMAN, D_MECH and EPI values listed below are module defaults in metres (0.10, 0.02 and 0.025 m). The experiment used per-run settings of 0.06, 0.012 and 0.012 m, recorded in clasp_params of every run log; in the paper they are R (person clearance) = 60 mm, d (mechanical clearance) = 12 mm and beta (fixed buffer) = 12 mm. The timeout comparison checks them.

constants.TIME_BASE_NOTE: capture proxy = t_request - source_age_s from the camera packet, host perf_counter clock: frame arrival at the Pi; excludes sensor exposure -> Pi, includes the request's one-way latency
